title: Potential Energy Function and Vibrational States of the Electronic Ground State of N4+
authors: Leonard C., Rosmus P., Carter S., Handy N.C.

species.method: RCCSD-T (also B3LYP, B97-1 reported, RCCSD-T preferred as most reliable per paper)

bond_params.description: Linear centrosymmetric N-N-N-N (X 2Sigma+u state). Converted from bohr as printed in paper (RCCSD-T: RN-N=2.097 bohr, RN...N=3.788 bohr) via 1 bohr=0.52917721 Angstrom. Structure is essentially two N2 units weakly bound (RN...N much longer than N2 bond, 'floppy' along bending per text). Alternative values also tabulated: B3LYP 2.072/4.048 bohr, B97-1 2.078/4.003 bohr.

species.notes: Genuine minimum (vibrational analysis performed, ground state). Not present in existing catalog (existing catalog has no N4+ entry at all per prior 70-structure list).
